SELECT count(*) FROM accommodation
WHERE (accommodation_name LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{search}, '%') OR tel LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{search}, '%'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accommodation ( accommodation_name, accommodation_address, tel, checkin, checkout, accommodation_contents, category_no, keyword_no, business_no ) VALUES ( #{acmName}, #{acmAddress}, #{acmTel}, #{checkinTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{contents}, #{categoryNo}, #{keywordNo}, #{businessNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.accommodation_no AS acmNo, a.accommodation_name AS acmName, a.accommodation_address AS acmAddress, a.accommodation_contents AS contents, a.checkin AS checkinTime, a.checkout AS checkoutTime, a.tel AS acmTel, a.keyword_no AS keywordNo, a.business_no AS businessNo, a.category_no AS categoryNo, c.category_name AS categoryName, GROUP_CONCAT(m.amenities_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS amenitiesName FROM accommodation a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN keyword k ON a.keyword_no = k.keyword_no LEFT JOIN accommodation_amenities am ON a.accommodation_no = am.accommodation_no LEFT JOIN amenities m ON am.amenities_no = m.amenities_no WHERE a.accommodation_no = #{acmNo} GROUP BY a.accommodation_no, c.category_name
SELECT k.keyword_no FROM accommodation a JOIN keyword k ON a.keyword_no = k.keyword_no WHERE a.accommodation_no = #{acmNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE accommodation SET accommodation_name = #{acmName}, accommodation_address = #{acmAddress}, tel = #{acmTel}, checkin = #{checkinTime}, checkout = #{checkoutTime}, accommodation_contents = #{contents}, category_no = #{categoryNo}, keyword_no = #{keywordNo} WHERE accommodation_no = #{acmNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_image (filename, filepath, accommodation_no) VALUES (#{filename}, #{filepath}, #{acmNo})
